excerpt.zh: 我们发现有一颗行星含有大量严重衰变的放射性同位素。建议进行更深入的调查。
excerpt.en: We have discovered a planet containing large quantities of heavily decayed radioactive isotopes. Further investigation is warranted.

texts.zh: 24000年之前，星系之中的一颗坍缩恒星发出的伽玛射线暴直接照射到了[From.GetName]星球表面。[From.GetPlanetMoon]被致命辐射覆盖，不仅面向射线的[From.GetName]大多数生命形态都被辐射感染，同时大部分的臭氧层也被破坏。这次大灭绝使星球大概86%的生物消失，包括早期青铜时代的文明，他们的遗迹至今仍然存在于北半球的一些地区。目前当地的生物圈有了一些恢复的迹象。
texts.en:
24,000 years ago [From.GetName] had the misfortune of being directly in the path of a long gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star within our galaxy. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was washed with lethal radiation, which not only produced acute radiation poisoning in most life forms on the side of [From.GetName] that happened to be facing the burst, but also depleted much of the ozone layer.

This extinction event killed off an estimated 86% of all biota, including an early Bronze Age civilization whose ruins can still be found in some parts of the northern hemisphere. The biosphere is only now showing signs of recovery.
